ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with approximately 35-40% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated in the distal regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the outer thirds of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits dense, vertical low-intensity striations and mottling within the white field. The central region near the peduncle and median notch is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 42 degrees and a depth ratio of approximately 1:5 relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the entire trailing edge. Serrations exhibit irregular amplitudes ranging from 3 to 15 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness on the distal edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory; concave curvature originating from the median notch transitioning to convex curvature as it approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast 'bullseye' marks (white core, black ring, white outer ring) located in the mid-section of both lobes. Prominent clusters of biological encrustations (barnacles) on the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense array of fine, high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks). Vertical orientation is dominant on the left lobe; diagonal/intersecting orientation is dominant on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula spp.) forming irregular 3D calcified masses on the left and right tips, disrupting the smooth geometric contour of the edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'double-ring' circular pigmentation patterns on the lower mid-section of the left lobe, functioning as a highly specific spatial identifier.
